test.title: Working from home: a manager’s view

texts.title: Working from home: a manager’s view

paragraphs.text: Since our office allowed staff to work from home two days a week, I have seen fewer sick days and no drop in the quality of work. Some managers worry that people at home are less productive, but I have found no evidence of that in my team. The real cost is harder to measure: new employees learn much less when experienced colleagues are not sitting beside them.

document.title: Working from home: a manager’s view

items.quote: I have seen fewer sick days and no drop in the quality of work
items.prompt: The writer has noticed that the quality of work has fallen since staff began working from home.

explanation.en: The writer says there has been “no drop in the quality of work”. The statement says the opposite → NO.
explanation.kk: Автор «no drop in the quality of work» дейді — жұмыс сапасы төмендемеген. Тұжырым керісінше айтады → NO.
explanation.ru: Автор пишет «no drop in the quality of work» — качество не упало. Утверждение говорит обратное → NO.

items.quote: new employees learn much less when experienced colleagues are not sitting beside them
items.prompt: The writer believes new employees should work in the office every day.

explanation.en: The writer sees a problem: new staff learn less without experienced colleagues nearby. But he never says they should be in the office every day → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Автор мәселені көреді: жаңа қызметкерлер тәжірибелі әріптестері қасында болмаса, аз үйренеді. Бірақ оларға күнде кеңсеге келу керек деп айтпайды → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Автор видит проблему: новички учатся меньше без опытных коллег рядом. Но что для них нужно ежедневно ходить в офис, он не говорит → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Look at the text. Do the following statements agree with the views of the writer? Write YES if the statement agrees with the views of the writer, NO if the statement contradicts the views of the writer, or NOT GIVEN if it is impossible to say what the writer thinks about this.

steps.en: Keywords: “quality of work”, “fallen”. The statement is about what the writer has noticed.
steps.kk: Тірек сөздер: «quality of work», «fallen». Тұжырым автордың не байқағаны туралы.
steps.ru: Ключевые слова: «quality of work», «fallen». Утверждение — о том, что заметил автор.

steps.en: The first sentence: “I have seen fewer sick days and no drop in the quality of work”.
steps.kk: Бірінші сөйлем: «I have seen fewer sick days and no drop in the quality of work».
steps.ru: Первое предложение: «I have seen fewer sick days and no drop in the quality of work».

steps.en: “No drop” means quality has not fallen. “Fallen” in the statement directly contradicts the writer.
steps.kk: «No drop» — сапа төмендемеген. Тұжырымдағы «fallen» автордың сөзіне тікелей қайшы.
steps.ru: «No drop» — качество не снизилось. «Fallen» в утверждении прямо противоречит словам автора.

steps.en: The writer’s view is the opposite → NO.
Keywords: “new employees”, “office every day”. Find what the writer says about new staff.
steps.kk: Тірек сөздер: «new employees», «office every day». Автордың жаңа қызметкерлер туралы не айтатынын іздейміз.
steps.ru: Ключевые слова: «new employees», «office every day». Ищем, что автор говорит о новичках.

steps.en: The last sentence: “new employees learn much less when experienced colleagues are not sitting beside them”.
steps.kk: Соңғы сөйлем: «new employees learn much less when experienced colleagues are not sitting beside them».
steps.ru: Последнее предложение: «new employees learn much less when experienced colleagues are not sitting beside them».

steps.en: The writer names a problem but offers no solution. “Every day in the office” is our guess, not his words.
steps.kk: Автор мәселені атайды, бірақ шешім ұсынбайды. «Күнде кеңседе болу» талабы — біздің болжамымыз, оның сөзі емес.
steps.ru: Автор называет проблему, но решения не предлагает. Требование «каждый день в офисе» — наша догадка, а не его слова.

steps.en: It is impossible to say what the writer thinks → NOT GIVEN.
steps.kk: Автордың не ойлайтынын айту мүмкін емес → NOT GIVEN.
steps.ru: Нельзя сказать, что думает автор → NOT GIVEN.
